papers.title: A Quantum Roadmap for Softmax Attention: Exact Born-Rule Analogs for Softmax Attention on the Probability Simplex
papers.identity: verified from official history and PDFp1 exact title/authors/revision/date
findings: P4 Assumption1/Remark2 use simplex inputs, values and outputs, lifted features and normalized overlaps; this is not the existing signed-feature/value Q-RMEA interface.

P8 Definition11/Proposition12 compile controlled token-register state preparation from classically known normalized cosine amplitudes, rather than the current per-token overlap/classical normalization.
P8-9 Theorem13 gives pointwise distribution-family equality via score=2log(cos(angle/2)); it does not equate restricted parameter-to-input function classes.

P9 Theorem14 strict boundary extension requires free angles reaching pi and zero numerators without a positive floor. Existing Q-RMEA adds epsilon1e-6 for every valid token, so this premise is absent.
transfer_assessment: The positive-score log-softmax identity is known and does not establish L5. It does not alone refute the fixed-head affine-curve separation: mapped log scores need not be affine functions of that curve.
Do not claim exact sparse-boundary expressivity for unchanged epsilon-smoothed Q-RMEA. The candidate concerns alternating strict class margins, a narrower different property.
limitations: Only listed pages read; no independent audit of full paper, code, Lean appendix or QSVT theorem.
No novelty clearance, natural-feature support or new task evidence.
